notes.title: Smoots Crazy Wave splashes on Steam today!
notes.content:
[p]🎉 The craziest jet-ski races are now available on [b]Steam[/b] & [b]Steam Deck[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Dive into [i]Smoots Crazy Wave[/i] 🌊, the latest game in the Smoots series! Enjoy fun racing for up to [b]4 players in split-screen mode[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Different modes await you: 🏆 [b]Championship[/b]: Become the ultimate jet-ski master! ↩️ [b]Slalom[/b]: Show off your precision and speed! 💥 [b]Battle Royale[/b]: Only one can survive!  ⏱  [b]Time Trial[/b]: Beat the clock and set records! 👓 [b]Practice[/b]: Learn all the circuits and perfect your skills![/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Play now on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Steam Deck[/b] — fully compatible! ✅
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3844020?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=steamevent"][/dynamiclink][/h3]
